notes.subject: ישר תפלס
notes.rationale: Read either 'O Upright One, you level the track of the righteous' (ישר as vocative, KJV/JPS) or 'the track of the righteous is level, made smooth' (noun reading); vocative chosen.

notes.subject: צדיק/צדיק
notes.rationale: 'Righteous' appears twice, beginning and end — an inclusio around the whole verse.

translation: Rot bilong man i gutpela long olgeta — em i stret olgeta; O yu i stret tru, yu mekim rot bilong man i gutpela i kamap plat stret.
